0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 113:1 , An exhortation to praise God for his excellency
0.body:
Psa 113:1 , An exhortation to praise God for his excellency;
Psa 113:6 , for his mercy.

1.heading: Title
refs: This and the following five Psalms form what is called by the Hebrews the great Hallel, or praise

which was sung on their most solemn festivals, and particularly after the celebration of the Passover. - See Matt 26:30 . Mark 14:26 . This and the following were probably composed after the return from the captivity.
1.body:
